title: Naturally Smoky Peruvian Reblochon Picarones
description: A smoky and gooey Peruvian dish featuring reblochon cheese, char-grill flavors, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients in a kid-friendly picarones form
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potato, Reblochon cheese, ancho chili powder, coconut sugar, egg, cassava flour, char-grill seasoning, and salt
Mix the ingredients until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball
Flatten each ball into a disk shape
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the picarones for 3 minutes on each side
Transfer the picarones to a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes
Serve the picarones warm and enjoy
